property.name: Axis
property.property_description:
Ideally located in the Chancellor Place neighbourhood on the University of British Columbia (UBC) campus, Axis is where higher learning meets inspired living.
Axis offers a mix of efficiently planned studios and one bedroom suites ranging from 410 to 550 square feet. Contemporary finishes, full kitchens and six energy-efficient appliances including dishwasher and in-suite laundry are standard throughout. At 15-storeys tall, many homes showcase stunning, unobstructed views of the water, city and North Shore mountains. With stylish interiors, quality construction, thoughtful amenities and our signature Concert On-Call customer service, you can have confidence in choosing Axis as your new home.
Environmental sustainability was kept top of mind in the development of this residence. Axis is targeted to meet the rigorous sustainability requirements of UBC’s REAP (Residential Environmental Assessment Program) Gold certification.
Please note only students, faculty, campus staff and employees of businesses located on campus are eligible to rent at Axis. Please view our criteria for residency for more information.

property.name: Whitgift Gardens
property.neighborhood_description: Whitgift Gardens is located adjacent to Cottonwood Park within easy walking distance to the Burquitlam Plaza neighbourhood shopping centre. The community is also within walking distance of both Mountain View and Roy Stibbs Elementary Schools. Lougheed Town Centre, hiking or biking on Burnaby Mountain, Simon Fraser University and the Millennium Skytrain Line are also nearby.
property.property_description:
Rental Office Hours: 10:00 – 5:00, Monday to Saturday
Whitgift Gardens is situated on an eight-acre site in West Coquitlam within close proximity to transit, schools, shopping and numerous parks. This extensive complex includes 12 three-storey apartment buildings containing a mix of one, two and three bedroom homes.
These generously-sized apartments come equipped with a stove, refrigerator, window coverings, carpeting in the primary living spaces and resilient flooring in the kitchen and bathroom. Every apartment has a balcony and comes with a parking space.

property.name: Fraser Pointe I and II
property.neighborhood_description:
Fraser Point is centrally located near the River District in southeast Vancouver, fronting the Fraser River and easily accessed from Marine Drive. Fraser Pointe is a short bus ride away from the new Canada Line SkyTrain route that makes commuting into downtown and getting to the airport fast and efficient. The Champlain Shopping Centre with Starbucks, Extra Foods, Kins Market and many other retails stores is just a short drive up Kerr Street.
Also located in the immediate area are Fraserview Public Golf Course, Killarney Community Centre with ice rink and pool, Champlain Heights Community Centre with fitness and racquet courts, as well as many walking and jogging paths. Champlain Heights Elementary and Killarney Secondary Schools are also nearby.
property.property_description:
Rental Office Hours: Noon-5pm Mon-Sat
Sister properties Fraser Pointe I and II make up an extensive complex which has something for everyone. With 16 two and three bedroom townhomes in addition to two 15-storey concrete towers Fraser Pointe offers a variety of modern studio, one bedroom, one plus den and two bedroom apartments.
Each suite comes with a stove, EnergyStar refrigerator, dishwasher (except with studios), colour coordinated blinds, carpeting in the primary living spaces, murphy beds in some cases and resilient flooring in the kitchen and bathroom. All townhomes have an in-suite washer and dryer, as well as private front patio and carport. The three bedroom layouts also include an extra half bath.
Most of the apartments have a balcony, many with spectacular views of the Fraser River, Mount Baker, the North Shore mountains and Vancouver Island.

property.name: The Bradford at Collingwood Village
property.neighborhood_description: The Bradford is just one block south of the Joyce SkyTrain station and close to neighbourhood conveniences and shopping such as Safeway, London Drugs and Starbucks. The area is dotted with parks, basketball and tennis courts, and playgrounds, with close proximity to Central Park and Metrotown Shopping Centre. Located in the immediate vicinity are Windermere Secondary School and Collingwood Neighbourhood House, which offer many community services and programs.
property.property_description:
Rental Office Hours: Noon-5pm Mon-Sat
This quality built four-storey luxury rental building, located in vibrant Collingwood Village, offers contemporary studios in addition to one and two-bedroom apartments. These bright, spacious, and well-designed apartments feature a ceramic-cooktop stove, EnergyStar refrigerator and dishwasher, in-suite washer and dryer, ample storage area, walk-in shower, colour coordinated window blinds, carpeting in the primary living spaces and resilient flooring in the kitchen and bathroom. All of the two bedroom suites have two bathrooms and some have breakfast nooks. Homes come with either a patio or balcony perfect for taking in the beauty of three-acre Gaston Park nearby, or simply enjoying the peaceful landscaped common garden and patio area.
The buildings have been designed with safety in mind; there are smoke detectors and sprinklers in addition to computer controlled building access and a video surveillance system. Other features include a main floor lounge for entertaining guests, a ping-pong table and access to a modern fitness room just across the courtyard, with cardio equipment, weights and a TV to make your workout more enjoyable. Vehicle parking, storage lockers and bicycle storage are also provided in a well-lit and gated underground parking facility.
Concert's professional on-site staff maintains the building premises and grounds, and is dedicated to making your Concert living experience a pleasant one. Our site office is open noon to 5pm Monday to Saturday for your convenience, with on-call service after hours to respond to your emergency needs.

property.name: Cassiar Court
property.neighborhood_description: The Rupert SkyTrain station is only a few blocks away. Neighbourhood conveniences include shopping and restaurants such as Save-on Foods, Staples, Earl's Restaurant, Brentwood Mall, Superstore, Walmart, London Drugs, and Zellers to name a few. Just across the street is Rupert Park offering pitch and putt, tennis courts and soccer fields.
property.property_description:
Rental Office Hours: Noon-5pm Tue-Sat
This well-designed, 48-home complex offers contemporary one and two bedroom garden apartments and three bedroom townhomes. The homes are bright and spacious with their own private entrance. Each home comes with a stove, EnergyStar refrigerator, dishwasher, storage space, colour coordinated window blinds, carpeting in the primary living spaces, and resilient flooring in the kitchen and bathroom.
Your new home also has its own furnace and hot water tank so personal comfort is in your control. All of the three bedroom homes have one and a half bathrooms. Enjoy the convenience of your own private patio or balcony, many with views of the North Shore mountains or Mount Baker, and for an alternate view - try the beautiful central courtyard. Cassiar Court is located on 1st Avenue, close to Highway 1 and just 20 minutes to downtown Vancouver.
The buildings have been designed with safety in mind; there are smoke detectors, sprinklers and CO2 detectors in each suite. Other features include a bright, central laundry facility, equipped with current SmartCard technology, making laundry time easy and convenient. Vehicle parking is available in the central parking area just outside your door, with plenty of parking for guests. There are also bicycle storage facilities conveniently located in the central courtyard area. Additionally, there is a comprehensive recycling station to help residents minimize their environmental footprint. Cassiar Court is pet friendly, so cats and dogs are welcome with some conditions.
Concert's professional on-site staff maintains the building premises and grounds, and is dedicated to making your Concert living experience a pleasant one. Our site office is open Tuesday to Saturday for your convenience, with on-call service after hours to respond to your emergency needs.

property.name: The Q Apartments
property.neighborhood_description: The Q Apartments are located between Victoria’s vibrant downtown core and the tree-lined James Bay neighbourhood, just steps away from the Parliament building. This central location provides a great variety of everyday amenities, shops, restaurants and entertainment. The close proximity to the downtown core and public transit access to major schools – University of Victoria, Camosun College and Royal Roads –make The Q a highly desirable rental building.
property.property_description:
Currently under renovation, The Q Apartments will offer studio, one and two bedroom rental homes. From compact furnished or unfurnished studios to spacious two bedroom homes, The Q Apartments will marry the mid-century modern aesthetic of this iconic 1960’s building with modern conveniences. Amenities include a resident lounge, card-operated laundry, bicycle storage and gym complete with a sauna and change rooms.
Move in early 2013.

Steps away from the Eaton Centre, Dundas Square, the financial district, hospitals, the University of Toronto and Ryerson University, Motion is the perfect choice for your new home.

Environmental sustainability was kept top of mind in the development of this project. Motion will target the highest level of the Toronto Green Standards (Tier 2) in addition to LEED Gold certification.
